title: Ship left dock
desc: Ship left dock, traveling about 0.5 knots (less than 1 mph)

title: Began arc
desc: Ship began an arc around Seagirt Marine Terminal, traveling about 4 knots (less than 5 mph)

title: Reached max speed
desc: Ship reached max speed of about 8.7 knots (10 mph), minutes before the crash

title: Ship loses power & first responders stop traffic
desc: Ship loses power for the third and final time before the crash, and puts out a distress call. First repsonders call to stop traffic on the bridge.

title: Hits bridge
desc: Ship hit the bridge - ""the whole bridge just fell down!"
